information:
This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about)! **Please check out the Southeast Cubing tab to learn more about the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast and what you can do to support the mission.**
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTEyNzEsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--48835820c0a2f7db4e39fda9f905a4bf335614a0/sexy.png)

The venue for this competition was graciously given to us for free. As a thank you for letting us use the space, any excess funds from this competition will be donated to Grace Presbyterian Church!
